Solve the perpendicular and horizontal frame by target curve division length

**Panel:** Comma → Plane · **Nickname:** `P&HFrame`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to evaluate |
| Length | `L` | Number | Item | `1000.00` | Target curve division length to approximate. |

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
